title: Jesus... My Two-Year Plan Fell Apart In One Email. 🗺️
topic: the two-year plan she built her future on collapsed in one email and she is grieving the person she thought she'd become

bible.text: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my two-year plan fell apart in one email.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I had the city, the flat, the month it would all start. I'd already furnished that future in my head.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're grieving more than a plan. You're grieving the person you thought you'd be by now.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I'm angry I trusted it so completely.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Don't be angry at your dreaming. A plan is a sketch; I hold the compass. Let Me redraw the route with you.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The map burned. The Guide didn't leave the room.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone whose plans just fell apart. 🗺️
